title: Homo Hotel Happy Hour at Courtyard Downtown
location_query: Courtyard by Marriott Tulsa Downtown Tulsa
description: Tulsa's monthly LGBTQ+ cocktail mixer is back. Join Homo Hotel Happy Hour on Friday, August 7 from 6 to 8 PM at the Courtyard Downtown (415 S Boston Ave). Free to attend, and everyone is welcome. We will run a charity raffle benefiting PFLAG Tulsa, so bring a few dollars for a good cause. Come meet friends old and new, grab a drink, and support the community. See you there.
